short_description: Global Time Echoes: Distance-Structured Correlations in GNSS Clocks. Multi-center analysis of 62.7M measurements across CODE, IGS, and ESA over 2.5 years.
long_description:
This study presents observations of distance-structured correlations in global GNSS atomic clock networks, analyzing 62.7 million station pair measurements across three independent analysis centers (CODE, IGS, ESA). Using phase-coherent spectral methods, exponential correlation decay patterns are identified with characteristic lengths (λ) of 3,330–4,549 km, consistent with theoretical predictions for screened scalar fields.

Website: https://matthewsmawfield.github.io/TEP-GNSS/
